records.issue_text: [Low/bug] app/assets/javascripts/discourse/models/group.js (removeMember) — after removing the last member of the final page, `offset` is not adjusted; `findMembers` clamps against the stale `user_count`, leaving the UI on an empty page beyond `totalPages`
records.rationale: In group.js, removeMember calls self.findMembers() after DELETE; findMembers clamps offset only against the stale user_count (`offset = Math.min(this.get("user_count"), Math.max(this.get("offset"), 0))`). Nothing in the diff reduces `offset` after a deletion, so removing the last member of the final page can request an offset at/beyond the new total, leaving the UI on an empty page. The mechanism is grounded in the diff; severity is minor.

records.rationale: The diff to admin-group-selector.hbs only removes blank lines: before the diff the file already contained the bare `<input type="text">` with no value binding (the context line ` <input type="text">` is unchanged; only surrounding empty lines `-` are deleted). The finding claims the component is 'now' a dead, unwired field, but this diff introduced no functional change to it — the described defect is pre-existing state, not something introduced or exposed by this diff. As a pre-existing issue outside the diff's changes, it is not a bug introduced here and the 'now' framing misreads the diff.

records.issue_text: [Medium/api] app/controllers/groups_controller.rb (members) — the response shape changed from a flat serialized array to `{ members: [...], meta: {...} }`, breaking existing API consumers of `GET /groups/:name/members`; related breaking changes in the same PR include removal of the admin PATCH `changes` endpoint and `get "users"` without deprecation
records.rationale: Verified in the diff: groups_controller.rb members changes `render_serialized(members.to_a, GroupUserSerializer)` to `render json: { members: ..., meta: ... }`, and routes.rb removes `get "users"` and the PATCH `changes` flow without deprecation. In-app consumers are updated (model.findMembers reads result.meta, members.hbs uses members), but external API consumers of GET /groups/:name/members face an unannounced breaking response-shape change. This is a real, specific compatibility concern grounded in the diff, not a defect within the app itself.

records.issue_text: [Medium/bug] app/assets/javascripts/admin/templates/group_member.hbs:1 — inside `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}` the template context is the member (a User), so `{{#unless automatic}}` looks up `automatic` on the user rather than the group controller; it's always undefined, so the remove link renders even for automatic groups where the server just 422s with no visible feedback
records.rationale: group_member.hbs is rendered as itemView inside `{{each member in members itemView="group-member"}}`, so the template context is the member (a Discourse.User — the template itself references `member.username`, confirming per-member context). `{{#unless automatic}}` therefore resolves `automatic` on the user, where it is undefined, so the remove link always renders even for automatic groups; the server's add/remove member endpoints return 422 for automatic groups (`return can_not_modify_automatic if group.automatic`), leaving the action to fail silently with no visible feedback. Ember property
